input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement. The licence grant (§ 2) is expressly non-exclusive, the use restrictions in § 3 are limited to copying, assignment, reverse engineering and protection of the Software, the Maintenance and Support provisions (§ 10 and § 11) require payment of maintenance fees but do not require Sparkling to source maintenance, support or any other products or services solely from Garman, and the General Matters section contains no minimum-purchase, requirements or non-compete covenant. The only other uses of "exclusive" are the non-exclusive escrow licence (p0115), the mutual exclusive-remedy provision (p0105) and non-exclusive jurisdiction (p0146), none of which restrict our freedom to buy elsewhere. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is needed.
